Queue management system

Customers take a ticket in Telegram or at a terminal, know the wait and can wait outside; the hall stays calm and staff load is visible. Qilich builds the MVP in 4–8 weeks, from UZS 72 mln; the full version in 10–16 weeks.

Questions

What does “Queue management system” cost?
At Qilich the MVP costs $6,000–12,000 (UZS 72–145 mln) and the full version $15,000–35,000 (UZS 180–425 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Queue management system” take?
Qilich builds the MVP in 4–8 weeks and the full version in 10–16 weeks.
What do we need to provide for “Queue management system”?
How the work runs today: who does what; existing data: Excel, notebooks or an old system; 1–2 staff to try the system.
